Read out of saint.gr's line for 5 Δεκεμβρίου, «Άγιος Κοσμάς ο Πρώτος ο Βατοπαιδινός ο Οσιομάρτυρας», with the rank words left off.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 5 decembrie — «Sfântul Cuvios Mucenic Cosma Athonitul»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 5ης Δεκεμβρίου — «Άγιος Κοσμάς ο Πρώτος ο Βατοπαιδινός ο Οσιομάρτυρας και οι συν αυτώ Οσιομάρτυρες του Αγίου Όρους»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 5 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder already keeps, and the entry is the same man: the Protos of the Holy Mountain who was hanged for refusing union under Michael VIII Palaiologos and the patriarch John Bekkos. Its head gives «(; - 1280)», the year of his death, which the folder did not hold. The entry's «και οι συν αυτώ Οσιομάρτυρες» enumerates nobody: the page names their monasteries — Vatopedi, Iviron, Zographou, Xenophontos — and no monk, so by the settled rule a company the page does not name is one folder and no folder is drafted for the companions. The page also refers the uncovering of his relics in 1981 to 18 Νοεμβρίου, which the corpus keeps as its own entry; this row records the day page read, 5 December. No hymn is printed, though the page says a full service and a paraklesis were composed by the hymnographer the hieromonk Athanasios Simonopetrites. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (25 September 2026).

death.note: saint.gr's head line, «Αγιος Κοσμας ο Πρωτος ο Βατοπαιδινος ο Οσιομαρτυρας (; - 1280)»; the same page dates the patriarchate of John Bekkos, under whom he suffered, to 1275 - 1282.
